body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces defensive normalizers to safely format and fallback input data (such as artifact cards, detail tasks, search groups, weak spot repair groups, and facet values) before they are rendered in various components, accompanied by a comprehensive test suite. The reviewer feedback focuses on strengthening these normalizers by defensively validating plain object properties, filtering and cleaning array elements to ensure they are valid non-empty strings, adding structured validation failures for malformed search groups, and using dedicated helper functions instead of inline lookups in components.

> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
